headline: Coal India shares fall 3% despite a 57% rise in Q2 net profit
hook: Profit jumps but brokerages trim targets
summary: Coal India reported a 57% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 6,547 crore for Q2 FY27. Despite the earnings growth, its stock fell 3% as major brokerages including Jefferies and JM Financial cut their target prices. Motilal Oswal retained its Buy rating with a Rs 450 target, pointing to an expected volume recovery. Indian retail investors holding the stock face near-term pressure despite strong headline profit numbers.
whats_next: Volume recovery data in upcoming operational updates
why_it_matters: Stock faces selling pressure despite strong profit growth.
winners_losers: Brokerages cautious / Coal India holders hurt
